description.value: Dae Bak Bon Ga is a long-running Korean BBQ restaurant on Vancouver's busy Robson Street, serving both à la carte and all-you-can-eat BBQ menus with over 140 seats for small and large groups. The restaurant has operated for more than 20 years and also features eight private karaoke rooms available for booking. It is located on the second floor (unit 201) of its building, presented by Mirak Foods Ltd.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 16m; stands (2 spaces) at 26m; stands (5 spaces) at 29m. Total: 9 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms the business is actively operating as a Korean BBQ restaurant with karaoke, celebrating its 20th anniversary in 2025 and running 2026 lunch specials. The website corroborates OSM phone and email exactly, but lists the address as '201-1323 Robson Street' (adding unit 201) versus OSM's '1323 Robson Street', which warrants flagging. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags; delivery via UberEats and SkiptheDishes is noted, supporting a takeout value of true.
concerns: Address mismatch: OSM lists '1323 Robson Street' but website consistently lists '201-1323 Robson Street' (unit 201, second floor). OSM tag 'level: 1' may indicate second floor but is ambiguous. Prefer website address.
